summary: Independent Phase 2B verification (NO pytest run, per constraint). Wrote /app/tests/phase2b_independent.py (standalone python, public preview URL + Mongo ground truth): 98 checks -> 94 effective passes, 3 genuine defects (1 medium, 2 minor), 4 initial failures were my own script's wrong assumptions (non-existent /api/metrics|/api/audit paths, source category 'TEST_MODE', case-detail key 'audit_trail') and were corrected. VERIFIED: (1) State machine - assert_transition allows all legal edges and raises ValueError on 6 illegal ones (VERIFIED_RECOVERED->OPEN, NATURALLY_RECOVERED->ACTION_EXECUTED, STOPPED->EVALUATED, EVALUATED->OPEN, NOT_RECOVERED->EVALUATED, INVALID->ACTION_EXECUTED); all 7 persisted statuses across 1181 cases are known states. (2) Fresh genuine-signature webhook probe (signed with the real stored TEST webhook secret, amount 250000 > approval_threshold so policy routed to APPROVAL_PENDING => NO action executed, no email; recipient was the Resend sink anyway): audit trail contained WEBHOOK_SIGNATURE_VERIFIED, WEBHOOK_RECEIVED, EVENT_NORMALIZED + CASE_CREATED, AI_ANALYSIS_STARTED, AI_ANALYSIS_COMPLETED (correctly ordered), POLICY_DECISION; all 21 canonical case fields present; provider_mode=TEST; failure_code captured. Probe fully deleted (case count back to 1181). (3) EIV replay: for all 87 action docs carrying eiv_inputs, recoverable_amount*incremental_probability - action_cost - risk_penalty == eiv_inputs.eiv exactly, and all 9 required input keys present. (4) Cron: unauthenticated 401, wrong secret 401, owner session token 401; with WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET (never printed) accepted:true/duplicate:false, replayed run_id -> duplicate:true, cron_runs reached COMPLETED (checked=724, provider_errors=129), verification_sweeps row + RECONCILIATION_COMPLETED audit written; my cron_runs/sweep/audit probe rows deleted. (5) LIVE readiness: anonymous 401, authorized 200, overall BLOCKED, 10 components all with honest reasons and statuses in READY/WARNING/BLOCKED, credentials=BLOCKED, signature-verification=WARNING, fail_closed_defaults match DB settings, no secret material in payload. (6) Health: all 5 new observability fields present and each numerically equal to its Mongo ground-truth count; last_sweep has no _id. (7) Case filters against DB ground truth: failure substring (count-exact, homogeneous, strict subset, empty on no-match), verification (PENDING/UNVERIFIED), attribution (MODERATE/NONE), min/max_amount (count-exact + bounds respected + empty at 1e9), created_from/created_to count-exact, combined filters narrow further, sort=eiv_desc monotonically non-increasing with max at top, sort=attention exactly (created_day asc, amount desc) and same population as default. (8) Regression: 11 GET endpoints 200 (dashboard summary, cost-ledger, settings, integrations, live, diagnostics, webhooks events/config, review queue, razorpay events, ingest batches), TEST_MODE case list loads, case detail + /replay 200 with audit_trail and no _id. FRONTEND (Playwright, session cookie): /integrations loads, live-section + live-warning production text render, live-readiness-btn enabled -> live-readiness-panel renders overall BLOCKED + all 10 per-component rows with colored status dots and reasons, all 4 new Integration Health rows render real values, no secrets in DOM, 0 error elements, no page errors; dashboard + case list (500 rows) + status filter + case detail Decision Replay all work.

minor.issue: Both call execute_action() WITHOUT expected_incremental_value, so the executed action document stores expected_incremental_value=0.0 while its own eiv_inputs.eiv is the real value (4 HUMAN_APPROVED actions currently: field 0.0 vs eiv_inputs.eiv 1338.0). Only the autopilot path (detection.py:630) passes it. This breaks the Phase 2B claim that an executed action's stored EIV replays exactly from eiv_inputs; auditors reading recovery_actions see 0. Fix: pass the recommended action's evaluation EIV from case.action_evaluations in routes_cases.py:300 and :342 (or derive it from eiv_inputs inside execution.py so it can never drift).

EVENT_NORMALIZED is audited TWICE for the same provider event: the first write carries the Phase-2B correlation_id + provider_mode, the second (legacy) write carries neither. Duplicate audit rows for one normalization step and inconsistent 2B metadata. Also WEBHOOK_RECEIVED has no correlation_id/provider_mode. Fix: delete the second EVENT_NORMALIZED write (merge its after_state into the first) and add correlation_id/provider_mode to WEBHOOK_RECEIVED.

Every sweep re-attempts provider fetch_order for all RAZORPAY_TEST cases whose order_key is not a real Razorpay order (test-lab/simulated ingests): the cron run reported provider_errors=129 and each writes a RECONCILIATION_FAILED audit, so the new reconciliation_failures counter is already 311 and grows unbounded on each sweep — it stops being a useful health signal. Consider marking a case MISSING_PROVIDER_DATA once and skipping re-fetch (or excluding known-synthetic order keys).

ui_bugs.issue: health.last_sweep is returned by the API but never rendered — the section only shows last webhook / last failed. Operators cannot see the last sweep time/results (the sweep result box only appears after clicking the manual sweep button, so cron-driven sweeps are invisible).

None of the new Phase 2B filters/sorts are exposed in the UI: only status/source/outcome/policy/search and sorts newest|oldest|amount_desc|amount_asc. failure, verification, attribution, min_amount/max_amount, created_from/created_to and sort=eiv_desc / sort=attention work on the API but are unreachable for users.

issues: Stale phase copy: LIVE section subtitle says 'Phase 2A readiness…' and GET /api/integrations/razorpay/live returns phase '2A readiness…' while the new readiness endpoint says 'Phase 2B readiness' — inconsistent product messaging.
Readiness panel contrast/spacing fine at 1920x1080; status dots (emerald/amber/red) map correctly to READY/WARNING/BLOCKED.

Recharts console warning repeated ~8x: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' — chart containers are measured at -1 during first paint; harmless but noisy, fix with a minWidth/minHeight on ResponsiveContainer.

action_items: Pass the real EIV into execute_action from the manual-execute and human-approve routes (or derive expected_incremental_value from eiv_inputs inside execution.py) so executed action docs never store 0.0 against a non-zero eiv_inputs.eiv.
Remove the duplicate legacy EVENT_NORMALIZED audit write in routes_webhooks.py and add correlation_id/provider_mode to WEBHOOK_RECEIVED.
Stop re-failing reconciliation on synthetic order keys every sweep (reconciliation_failures counter is already inflated to 311).
Expose the Phase 2B case filters (failure/verification/attribution/amount range/date range) and sorts (eiv_desc, attention) in the case list UI.
Render health.last_sweep in the Integration Health section so cron sweeps are observable.
Update the stale 'Phase 2A readiness' copy in Integrations.jsx and in GET /api/integrations/razorpay/live.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_cron.py auth is correct (constant-time hmac.compare_digest, empty-secret fails closed, idempotent on run_id before insert, BackgroundTasks handoff). Small race: two concurrent identical run_ids can both pass the find_one check — a unique index on {run_id, job} would make idempotency airtight.
sweep_core is genuinely shared by the manual route and the cron (no parallel implementation) and only reconciles TEST-sourced cases with TEST credentials — mode isolation holds.
live_readiness never returns READY while any component is non-READY and keeps signature-verification at WARNING until last_successful_event_at exists — honest by construction.

list_cases loads up to 5000 case docs plus (for stage filters) 10000 cases + 10000 actions into memory per request and sorts in Python; fine at 1.2k cases, will need DB-side sorting/pagination before scale.

eiv_inputs on the action doc is resolved by matching action_type against case.action_evaluations; if no evaluation matches it silently stores null (631 legacy actions have no eiv_inputs). Consider making eiv_inputs mandatory for newly executed actions.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-run /app/tests/phase2b_independent.py (python3, non-pytest) for Phase 2B regression; it self-cleans. Note: the cron sweep takes ~1-3 min and the script polls up to 5 min. Known API path facts: there is no /api/metrics or /api/audit; case detail returns keys case/attempts/actions/audit_trail/provider_events; the source filter takes source_category values (TEST_MODE/SIMULATED/IMPORTED/LIVE); GET /api/settings nests the policy under 'settings'. The webhook probe used amount>approval_threshold_amount (50000) to force APPROVAL_PENDING so no recovery action/email fires — keep that trick. Open defects: action-level expected_incremental_value=0.0 on human-approved executions, duplicate EVENT_NORMALIZED audit, inflated reconciliation_failures.
rca_of_the_issue: EIV field drift: execute_action(expected_incremental_value: float = 0.0) is called with the real value only from the autopilot (detection.py:630); routes_cases.py:300 (manual execute) and :342 (human approve) omit the argument, so the persisted action document's expected_incremental_value defaults to 0.0 even though eiv_inputs (resolved separately from case.action_evaluations) holds the true 1338.0. Reproduce: approve a case in the review queue, then read the created recovery_actions doc — expected_incremental_value 0.0 vs eiv_inputs.eiv 1338.0. Mitigation: derive the field from eiv_inputs inside execution.py so the two can never diverge. Duplicate EVENT_NORMALIZED: routes_webhooks.py writes the audit twice (lines ~243 and ~261); the second, legacy call lacks correlation_id/provider_mode.
